Hymn 125: How Gentle God's Commands
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major

This is hymn number 125 titled "How Gentle God's Commands" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Hans Georg Nägeli and the lyrics were written by Philip Doddridge.
